name: Imprisonment of the Eldrazi
description: The planeswalkers' trapping of the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar in -1400 AR.

description_citations.text: "Ulamog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The compromise by which the three planeswalkers bound the Eldrazi on Zendikar rather than kill them.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
